item.title: Two new exhibitions opening at Peoria Riverfront Museum
item.description: The Peoria Riverfront Museum has opened two new exhibitions, "The Athletes" and "The Richrath Exhibition", as part of its Peoria Plays America series, celebrating local people who made a national impact during America 250.

item.title: Crowds of Chicago mourners pay respects to Jesse Jackson at start of cross-country memorial services
item.description: Crowds of mourners lined up in Chicago as cross-country memorial services for the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. began Thursday in the city the late civil rights leader called home.

item.title: Man arrested for alleged child exploitation in Tazewell County
item.description: A 35-year-old man from Marquette Heights was arrested in Tazewell County for alleged child exploitation, including possession and dissemination of child sexual abuse materials.

item.title: Normal crews respond to crash on Veterans Parkway
item.description: A three-vehicle traffic crash in Normal, Illinois caused temporary lane blockages, but no injuries were reported.

item.title: Illinois Gaming Board OKs Par-A-Dice Casino's water plan
item.description: The Illinois Gaming Board has approved Boyd Gaming's $160 million renovation of the Par-A-Dice casino, which will be located on a permanently moored barge next to the riverboat, and construction is expected to begin soon.

item.title: Miller Park Zoo opens voting to name baby wallaroo
item.description: People can donate to vote for the name of the baby wallaroo at the Miller Park Zoo, with the winner being announced on March 9th.

item.title: Former Peoria pastor arraigned for dissemination of harmful materials
item.description: Michael S. Ritchason, the former head pastor of a Downtown Peoria church, has been charged with sending sexually explicit images to a teenage boy and will return to court in mid-March for another hearing.

item.title: Shootin' the Breeze | Ep. 103: Reed Timmer visits central Illinois
item.description: Reed Timmer, extreme meteorologist and storm chaser, joins Your Local Weather Authority to discuss storm chasing and the data he collects while in the field, as well as the February tornado outbreak in central and northern Illinois back in 2017.

item.title: Peoria County Farm Bureau moving to new location next year, selling current building
item.description: The Peoria County Farm Bureau is selling its current building and relocating to a new building in Edwards, near Kickapoo, by next year.

item.title: Breanna Rittman inspires at Franklin Primary's Black History event
item.description: Franklin Primary School held its annual Black History Program with WMBD's Breanna Rittman as the keynote speaker, emphasizing the importance of representation in education and inspiring students to make an impact in their community.
